name: Monkey Bar Traverse
description: A continuous traverse across a series of horizontal bars or rungs moving hand over hand. The movement demands grip endurance, shoulder stability, and rhythm. Used in obstacle courses, military fitness tests, and gymnastics, the traverse develops forearm endurance and lat strength.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Monkey Bar Traverse in proper strongman position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare all equipment and body position for Monkey Bar Traverse.
steps: Step 1: Hang from first bar with both hands.
Step 2: Swing body forward and reach for next bar with alternating hands.
Step 3: Continue traverse with rhythmic hand-over-hand movement.
Step 4: Traverse full length and dismount safely at the end.
execution.breathing_instructions: Brace core maximally before every lift. Breathe between reps if needed.
common_mistakes: Gripping too tightly causing forearm fatigue
safety_considerations: Use collars on all loaded barbells.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full range of motion specific to the implement being used.
coaching_cues: Loose grip between catches to save forearms
